items.item_text: Certified Radiologic Technologist (CRT) license or American Registry for Diagnostic Medical Sonography (ARDMS) certification.
Basic Life Support (BLS) from the American Heart Association, or American Red Cross.

BS degree in a radiology division accredited by the Commission on Accreditation of Allied Health Education Programs (CAAHEP) or the Joint Review Committee on Education in Radiologic Technology (JRCERT).
Minimum 10 years of radiology related experience or training.
Minimum  4 years demonstrated in the supervision or management of staff.

Join UCLA Health as an Imaging Services Manager at MLK Community Hospital, where you'll have the opportunity to lead a dynamic imaging team, drive operational excellence, and make a meaningful difference in the lives of the patients and communities we serve.

In this key leadership role, you'll oversee the daily operations and strategic direction of a comprehensive, 24/7 imaging program, ensuring the delivery of exceptional, patient-centered care across multiple imaging modalities. You'll play an integral role in shaping departmental success through team development, operational efficiency, financial stewardship, quality improvement, and regulatory compliance.

We're looking for a forward-thinking, collaborative leader who thrives in a fast-paced healthcare environment and is passionate about empowering teams, improving processes, and elevating the patient experience. Your ability to think strategically, leverage data to drive decisions, and build strong interdisciplinary partnerships will be essential to your success.
As a leader at UCLA Health, you'll champion our CI-CARE principles, foster a culture of accountability and innovation, and help advance our commitment to delivering world-class healthcare.
